description: Score a single guide RNA against on-target quality heuristics (library heuristic; each CHOPCHOP self-complementary 4-bp stem deducts 1 point). The guide must be A/C/G/T (U is read as T).

fullGuideRna.description: Spacer + the system's sgRNA scaffold (76 nt SpCas9/SpCas9-NAG/NGA, 77 nt SaCas9); null for Cas12a/CasX, which have no sgRNA scaffold.

context30Mer.description: 30-nt Rule Set 2 context (4 nt upstream + 20-nt protospacer + 3-nt PAM + 3 nt downstream) of a designed 20-nt, 3-nt-PAM-after-target guide with its flanks in the sequence; null otherwise (evaluate_guide_rna never has one).

onTargetScore.description: Doench 2016 Rule Set 2 / Azimuth on-target score in 0..1 for context30Mer; null without a context.

grafMotif.description: Graf 2019 inefficiency motif at the PAM-proximal end of an NGG guide (reported, no score effect).

selfComplementaryStems.description: CHOPCHOP 4-bp self-complementary stem count (1 point of penalty each).

errors.message: Guide sequence cannot be null or empty
Expected A/C/G/T (U is read as T) but found '{char}' at index {i}.
Guide length ({n}) does not match expected length ({L}) for {system}.
parameters invalid: GC window not 0 <= minGcContent <= maxGcContent <= 100, NaN minScore, negative maxSelfComplementaryStems, or all-zero parameters.
